new.n: Conrad May's buried $45,000, Town of Jamestown near Dickeyville (find disputed)
new.pl: Town of Jamestown, S/W part of sec 12 T2N R3W: house mark just W of the N-S road about 400 m S of Louisburg; Dickeyville about 4.5 mi ESE (c.1915 Hixson plat, Jamestown p.94)
new.st: Conrad May reportedly buried about $45,000, mostly gold, to keep it from an alimony claim. In Oct 1897 the Dubuque Times said a neighbour's dog turned it up in a gopher hole, and the "find" was "the reigning sensation in Dickeyville". A week later the Cuba City News investigated and denied the Times' account. Find disputed: every report of the recovery traces to one Dubuque Times story, which the Cuba City News denied a week later. Whether anything was ever buried, or found, is unproven. Pin is on the c.1915 plat house mark, not the spot itself.
new.t: Find disputed: if the Cuba City News was right, nothing was dug up. Look around the old farmstead and fence lines. Private farmland: permission.

pinev: Farm-level: the c.1915 Hixson Grant plat (Jamestown p.94) shows a May parcel in the S/W part of sec 12 T2N R3W with a house mark just W of the N-S road about 400 m S of Louisburg; whether this is the 1897 farm is not proven (about 600 m).
